hypothesis_rationale: The frozen Suit2 row names SuitBuff BlueprintGeneratedClass'Buff_Equipment_Nature2_4_C' for SuitCondition 4 with SuitModifyPackID None; CT_Equipmentbuff carries three single-coordinate-one curves: Nature2_4_CritDamage=0.08, Nature2_4_Stack=7.0, Nature2_4_CD=10.0. The 0.08 value is read as 8% additional CRIT DMG and the 10.0 as 10 seconds per stack, matching the frozen tooltip ('Increases wearer's CRIT DMG by 8% ... up to 7 stacks. Each stack lasts 10s. Effect remains active when the character is off-field.'). The seconds-to-microseconds reading of Nature2_4_CD is the explicit unit hypothesis carried by NATIVE_GEAR_PROJECTION_CONTRACT's restricted policy native_mind_royale_fireflies_solo_v1. Three code-level model hypotheses bound the runtime: (1) fireflies.proc_v1 (Studio gear_assumptions): nearby Anima hits grant the wearer CRIT damage stacks with independent deadlines and no refresh at cap; (2) fireflies.team_anima_hit_v1: a connected nonzero elemental Anima packet from any living team member grants one independent stack to each living Fireflies wearer, including off-field wearers; a wearer does not grant an extra stack merely for being the source; (3) fireflies.origin_target_nearby_v1: the source's 'nearby enemy' condition is modeled as the scenario's origin target [0,0,0]; range and multi-target geometry are unresolved and rejected. Strict mode requires exact acceptance of the reached hypotheses (covered by fireflies_hypotheses_require_exact_strict_acceptance).
independent_oracles: Native parameter projection: ntesim_data::set_passive_values::fireflies requires exactly one SuitCondition-4 effect, SuitModifyPackID None, the Buff_Equipment_Nature2_4 object path, nonempty geometry conditions, and exactly one Time=1.0 key per curve with Linear/Constant interpolation; any drift errors. Values read: Nature2_4_CritDamage 0.08, Nature2_4_Stack 7, Nature2_4_CD 10 (CT_Equipmentbuff rows verified byte-identical against evidence tables).

Config validation: Fireflies proc requires equipped set:Suit2, 1..=64 stacks and positive duration; gear::validation rejects duplicate gear procs, so one stack per wearer per packet holds under validation.

Scenario oracle (solo path, research_request): crit_damage_per_stack 1/4, cap 2, duration 25us, hits at 0/10/20/30/40 -> damages [800, 900, 1000, 900, 900]: +0.25 CD per stack adds exactly +12.5% relative damage each (additive zone), cap hit queues fireflies_stack_capped without refresh, independent expiries at 25/35 drop the stack count back to 1 for hits at 30/40, and final fireflies_stacks is 0. A second scenario (cap 1, duration 10) shows hit at t=10 dealing 800: the stack expiring at the exact hit timestamp expires before the hit, and the triggering hit excludes its own new stack.

Team-path unit tests (new, on_team_hit called directly with a synthetic connected Anima packet; the runner reaches this path only for connected hits per hit/effects.rs): teammate source grants the off-field wearer (active_actor_index=1) exactly one stack with expires_at_us=15_000_000 and crit_damage_bonus 2/25; the non-wearer teammate admits none; the wearer's crit_damage_bonus modifier key aggregates to 2/25 through get_stat_modifiers_for_actor_with_living_sources while off-field; both hypothesis IDs are recorded with exact text. Wearer-as-source grants exactly one stack (no self double-grant); defeated source grants nothing; off-element Chaos packet grants nothing.

CRIT DMG zone additivity (existing manager_crit_damage_sources_are_summed_once_across_gear_and_kit_owners): one hit shows multiplier exactly 1 + 1/2 (static) + 1/4 (Fireflies stack) + 1/4 (Mint A5) + 3/25 (Haniel A6) = 2.12, i.e. stacks sum inside the single CRIT DMG zone per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT section 1 (calculation.rs sums buff_stat("crit_damage_bonus") across active instances).
limits: The 4pc is a modeled research path, not verified native execution. The unit reading of Nature2_4_CD (seconds -> microseconds) and the trigger/eligibility/recipient scope, clocks, ICD and refresh semantics are the explicit hypotheses above; native consumer semantics are not established. The NATIVE_GEAR_PROJECTION_CONTRACT restricted policy native_mind_royale_fireflies_solo_v1 stays the only supported native-projection model (solo Mint, one actor, one origin target).

The team path (on_team_hit) is unit-tested directly; it is reachable in full scenarios only through NativeDirect/OwnerChild bindings, which research-declared scenarios do not produce. No full end-to-end native multi-actor team scenario was run in this lane.
Range/multi-target geometry is unsupported: on_team_hit rejects anything but exactly one target at [0,0,0]; 'nearby enemy' beyond the origin target is unresolved.

The 4pc deliberately stays out of the static build path: static builds retain the SuitBuff blueprint reference in unresolved_set_buffs at threshold 4 (correct), and the static evaluator cannot execute it.

The receipt no longer claims 'four-piece CRIT DMG stacks marked unsupported in the static build path' as a blanket statement, nor that 'no Studio set_procs entry exists' — both were false: set_procs["set:Suit2"] threshold 4 exists and the proc, callback and both hit handlers are implemented and tested.
return_condition: Reopen only with frozen evidence or a concrete revised method for: native stack refresh semantics (the model uses independent per-stack expiry with no refresh at cap as tested rules), native trigger consumer behavior (team participation, nearby-enemy geometry, multi-target), and the Nature2_4_CD unit binding. Until then the model keeps the three stated hypotheses with exact-acceptance enforcement in strict mode, and the restricted solo-Mint research projection remains the only supported native parameter projection.
